_comment: A stored `run` report, to diff the replayed git-server run against.
Hand-tuned so every comparison case is exercised by construction rather than by luck.
The replayed run scores 100 / 60 / 80 / 75, and its smallest scored scenario has 4 trials,
so the noise floor is minNoise(4) = 25%:
create-branch             90 -> 100  improved, and fixed (it failed here, passes there)
create-branch-colloquial 100 ->  60  a 40-point drop, past the floor: a regression
no-tool-needed            95 ->  80  a 15-point drop, inside the floor: NOT a regression,
though it is a new failure against its 95% threshold
orphans is empty, so `delete_branch` reads as a new orphan.
The model is an alias rather than a dated snapshot, which must warn.
The provenance block must match what the replayed run produces exactly — provider, reasoning,
tool search and regime hash are all refused on, so a stale value here reads as a refusal
rather than as the comparison the rest of this fixture exists to exercise.

scenarios.prompt: make me a branch called feature-login
can you branch off main for the login work
